reviews.name: Alexandra Vorbe
reviews.text: Knight Group was professional, on time, honest, and very reasonably priced. We thought we needed a new door, but they were able to repair it instead and saved us a lot of money. Great work and highly recommend!

ownerReply.name: Knight Group Handyman Services
ownerReply.text: Thanks a lot Alex! He said it was a great door, would have been a shame to replace!

reviews.name: Kathleen Stewart
reviews.text: Nick from Knight’s group installed a shower bar for us. Came back twice after studying the problem so we could have 500 pounds of weight on the bar bought the bar for us and installed it pleasant young man we will use them again.

ownerReply.name: Knight Group Handyman Services
ownerReply.text: Thank you so much! I really appreciate this! Was a pleasure! Look forward to working with you again!

reviews.name: Carter Whetstone
reviews.text: Provided fast and efficient service; as well as a friendly attitude.

reviews.name: Tony Brown
reviews.text: Vince was very professional and skilled. Flexible to be able to do small and large projects. Great work ethic.

ownerReply.name: Knight Group Handyman Services
ownerReply.text: Much appreciate Tony, it was a pleasure!

reviews.name: Jesse Crawford-Lang
reviews.text: Very professional and efficient. Fine stars

reviews.name: Kevin Poe
reviews.text: Very professional, thorough, and dedicated to quality work.  Highly recommended!  He has completed several jobs for us and will definitely be our first call in the future.

ownerReply.name: Knight Group Handyman Services
ownerReply.text: Thank you for your quality review!

reviews.name: Patricia farrell
reviews.text: Great service, fast response, Vince was really professional and the pricing was extremely fair. Very quality experience and i will definitely be recommending them my friends and using them for future products.

reviews.name: Landon Hyder
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with The Knight Group! They were professional, efficient, and extremely knowledgeable.They completed the job quickly had fair pricing. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Dan M
reviews.text: By far the best plumbing experience I've had. Good communication, he arrived on time, completed the work quickly, and was professional throughout. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Nicholas Moser
reviews.text: Had a pipe burst at my restaurant and Vinny showed up early and replaced it in a little over an hour. Not mention the fact that it was the best work done in this place and at a great price. Highly recommend !

ownerReply.name: Knight Group Handyman Services
ownerReply.text: Thank you so much for the review!

reviews.name: Tom and Jamee Walters
reviews.text: Vinny came out to run a water line for me. He was on time and communicated clearly what he could do for me and actually saved me money by not over complicating the job. Def will use them again.

reviews.name: Brian Oconnor
reviews.text: Vince did a great job unclogging my drain and repairing the damage Drywall caused from the hurricane
